The '''First Duchess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]]. The [[Celestial Record]], a lost artifact, described the coming of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and giving intelligence and wisdom to the First [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]].
